```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ext_ent "<!ENTITY internal 'resolved_text'>">
  %ext_ent;
  <!ENTITY ref "&internal; and more">
  <?pi-target data="value"?>
]>
<root xmlns="http://example.org/root" xmlns:sub="http://example.org/sub" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Comment highlighting entity and namespace combination -->
  <sub:child xlink:type="simple">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block with entity reference: &ref; inside namespace <sub:child>
    ]]>
  </sub:child>
  <child>&ref;</child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE doc [
  <!ELEMENT doc (section+)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent "EntityValue">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
]>
<doc xmlns="http://ns.example.com/doc" xmlns:m="http://ns.example.com/meta">
  <!-- First comment -->
  <m:section m:id="s1">
    <?m-pi processing="true"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Nested CDATA containing markup: <section>&ent;</section>
    ]]>
  </m:section>
  <section>&ent;</section>
</doc>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY e1 "Val1">
  <!ENTITY e2 "&e1; Val2">
  <?catalog-process mode="strict"?>
]>
<catalog xmlns="http://example.org/catalog" xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude">
  <!-- Comment before CDATA and entity usage -->
  <item xi:include="fallback.xml">
    <![CDATA[
      <!-- Comment inside CDATA -->
      Data &e2; test
    ]]>
  </item>
</catalog>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (stock)*>
  <!ELEMENT stock (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base "BaseText">
  <!ENTITY extended "&base; ExpandedText">
  <?app-debug log="enabled"?>
]>
<inventory xmlns="http://example.org/inv" xmlns:v="http://example.org/version">
  <!-- Top comment block -->
  <v:stock v:status="active">
    <?v-cmd execute="true"?>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section with entity reference: &extended;
    ]]>
  </v:stock>
  <stock>&extended;</stock>
</inventory>
```
